Class CreateCityController

java.lang.Object
controller.CreateCityController
public class CreateCityController extends Object
Controller responsible for the creation and validation of cities on maps.

Provides methods to validate city and map names, validate center and block positions, create cities, and add blocks (both manual and automatic assignment).

      public CreateCityController.NameMapError validateNameMap(String name, String map)
      Validates whether the specified city name and map name are acceptable.
      Parameters:
      name - the desired city name

      NameMapError#OK if valid; NameMapError#MAP_NOT_FOUND if the map does not exist; NameMapError#NAME_DUPLICATE}if the name is already used on the map

    • validateCity

      public boolean validateCity(String cityName, String mapName, int x, int y)
      Validates the city name and map name for creating a new city.
      Parameters:
      cityName - the desired city name
      mapName - the name of the map to use
      x - the x-coordinate of the center
      y - the y-coordinate of the center
      Returns:
      true if both names are valid and coordinates are acceptable; false otherwise

    • validateCenter

      public CreateCityController.CenterError validateCenter(String map, int x, int y)
      Validates the center coordinates for a new city on a map.
      Parameters:
      map - the map name where the city will be placed
      x - the x-coordinate of the center
      y - the y-coordinate of the center
      Returns:
      CenterError#O if valid; CenterError#OUT_OF_BOUNDS if coordinates are outside bounds or map missing; CenterError#POSITION_TAKEN if another city center exists there; CenterError#BLOCK_PRESENT if a house block occupies the position

    • validateBlock

      public CreateCityController.BlockError validateBlock(String map, HouseBlock b)
      Validates a house block's coordinates on a map.
      Parameters:
      map - the map name where the block will be placed
      b - the HouseBlock with coordinates to validate
      Returns:
      BlockError#OK if valid; BlockError#OUT_OF_BOUNDS if outside bounds or map missing; BlockError#COLLIDES_CITY_CENTER if collides with a city center; BlockError#COLLIDES_BLOCK if collides with another block
